resources.string: ✓ Key saved — the proofreader is ready
Get a key at openrouter.ai/keys (cloud proofreading sends sentence text to OpenRouter)
%1$s via OpenRouter — Your writing is processed in the cloud by Google with ZDR (zero data retention)
Dictation uses the phone\'s built-in speech recognizer. The microphone permission can only be granted here, not from the keyboard.
Microphone permission not granted — voice typing is off. If the system dialog no longer appears, enable the permission in system Settings.

Words the swipe decoder should know (names, jargon, slang). Type or paste them separated by anything — spaces, commas, newlines all work. They are used for swipe typing only and never leave the device.
✓ %1$d custom words saved — active next time the keyboard opens

Records every swipe (trail + key geometry + decoder results) to a local file for decoder tuning. The file never leaves the device. Pull it with: adb run-as com.example.betterswipekeyboard cat files/swipe_trails.jsonl — turn off and clear when done.
